periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique inward-downward orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with the vertical/diagonal axis significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering resulting in a teardrop-like extension below the eye center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary where black pixels meet the white mid-back fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 40% of the visible torso length from the neck to the mid-section.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation positioned at the 10 o'clock and 2 o'clock positions on the cranial perimeter.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semi-circular with a slightly flattened top on the viewer's right ear and a subtle angular peak on the viewer's left ear.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-tan chromatic shift in the fur of the lower abdomen and hindquarters compared to the bright white fur of the head.
